QuestInfo.name: [Elodin] Hay Necessities
QuestInfo.0: The lantern full of wisps lit up the room nicely. It's so cozy now! What's #b#p1501001##k got to say?
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1501001##k asked you to collect Hay in #b#m101082100##k.
QuestInfo.2: Now that you've collected plenty of Hay, ask #b#p1501001##k what to do with it.

0.msg: Look at this mess! That menace must have shaken ten years worth of dust from the rafters with all his screeching!

1.msg: Let's start by gathering up all the Hay Bundles around the house.

2.msg: Me? Why in the world would I...

3.msg: Because I asked nicely? Thank you!

1.msg: The Hay Bundles are your best source of Hay... But you knew that, of course. If you go to the right, you'll find quite a few of them.

0.msg: You can't do me this small favor?
What's taking so long? We need Hay, remember?
